Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a statewide ORV data base.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a statewide offroad vehicle data base; andamending RCW 46.09.250.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.09.250 and 1986 c 206 s 11 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The ((interagency)) committee ((for outdoor recreation)) shallmaintain: (1) A statewide plan which shall be updated at least once everythird biennium and shall be used by all participating agencies to guidedistribution and expenditure of funds under this chapter; and (2) A statewide data base of ORV trails, ORV sports parks, andother ORV recreation areas open to the general public. The data basemust be based on a global information systems program and include allstate and federal lands open for public ORV use. The data base must beavailable to the public over the committee's internet web site. Actualdevelopment and maintenance of the data base must be outsourced by thecommittee through a competitive grant provided to a qualifiedapplicant. Funding for the grant must be provided consistent with p. 1 HB 2658other programs conducted under this chapter by the committee asprovided in RCW 46.09.240(1).
